title: HR Manager
description:
Anode Electric Private Limited | Wire & Cable Manufacturing Company: Anode Electric Private Limited
Work Location: Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh
Experience Required: 5-8 Years (Manufacturing / Industrial sector preferred)
Qualification: MBA / PGDM in HR, or equivalent; Labour Law diploma preferred
Gender Preference: Male candidates preferred
Location Preference: Candidates local to Jabalpur preferred Job Summary Anode Electric Private Limited is looking for an experienced HR Manager to independently handle end-to-end HR operations for our manufacturing unit in Jabalpur including manpower management, statutory compliance, payroll, HRMS administration, and employee welfare. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with factory/industrial HR compliance (PF, ESIC, Factory Act) and be comfortable managing both blue-collar (factory workers) and white-collar (office staff) workforce. Key Responsibilities 1. HRMS & Payroll Management Operate HRMS software (attendance, leave, payroll module) with accurate daily data updates Process monthly payroll - salary calculation, deductions, attendance-based pay Maintain employee database (HRMS + physical records) 2. Statutory Compliance PF (Provident Fund) registration, monthly contribution, and return filing (ECR) ESIC registration, monthly contribution, and return filing Labour Welfare Fund, Professional Tax, Bonus Act, and Gratuity compliance Maintain registers and file returns required under the Factory Act Handle renewal, claims, and documentation of insurance policies (Group Mediclaim, Workmen Compensation/EPLI) Contract labour (CLRA) compliance, where applicable Keep documentation audit-ready for government inspections 3. Manpower & Recruitment Manpower planning for factory workers and office staff End-to-end recruitment (sourcing, interview coordination, offer letters) from shop floor to management level Handle onboarding and induction process Manpower budgeting aligned with production requirements 4. Employee Relations & Welfare Handle grievances for factory workers and office staff Manage disciplinary actions, show-cause notices, and domestic enquiry procedures Coordinate employee welfare activities (safety, canteen, transport facility) Liaise with union/worker committee, where applicable 5. Policy & Documentation Draft and implement HR policies (leave policy, code of conduct, etc.) Issue appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience/relieving letters Manage exit process - full & final settlement, exit interviews 6. Reporting Provide monthly HR MIS reports to management (headcount, attrition, compliance status) Maintain statutory compliance tracker with due-date reminders Required Skills Hands-on experience with HRMS software (Zoho People, Keka, greytHR, or similar industry-standard tools) Strong practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, and Labour Laws (not just theoretical) Actual hands-on experience in return filing (not just supervisory) Proficiency in MS Excel for attendance/payroll data Manufacturing/Factory HR background - mandatory Good communication skills to work with both workers and management Preferred Experience in Wire, Cable, or similar heavy manufacturing industry Direct coordination experience with labour law consultants/compliance vendors Salary: As per experience
 Reporting To: Management / Director
 Eligibility: Male candidates from Jabalpur preferred

Key Skills: HRMS & Payroll Management,Manpower Planning,Employee Grievance Handling,Recruitment & Talent Acquisition,Statutory Return Filing,Employee Relations,PF & ESIC Compliance,Factory Act Compliance
